*Topics — What a work is about. **Individuation** — what makes something one thing, and the same thing over time or across descriptions — individuation, numerical identity and diversity, individuality and persistence of things of any kind, biological individuality and organisational closure. Selves are self and persons are personhood (group: philosophy; ADR-015, ADR-024).

| [CASE-334](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-334.md) | Block test on a phi4 kink and Kuramoto cluster | [LEAD-083](../../../record/leads.d/LEAD-083.md)'s study. Three arms share one protocol: [CLAIM-157](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-157.md)'s block test on the members, compensation read as in a jaw-load experiment (a sustained load on a few members, the form's task variable read with the others free and with them frozen), and entrainment read as [CLAIM-172](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-172.md) reads it, by timing. In the kink of an overdamped phi4 lattice the sites within about one unit of its centre compensate fully, and the set that compensates moves with the kink. Coupling between sites is uniform, and the best block ratio of a segment holding the kink falls as the square of the lattice spacing, from 1.57 to 0.11. In a Kuramoto population with uniform coupling, the 156 locked oscillators of 200 compensate (0.97) and entrain (0.91), and on the coupling constants every subset of 156 scores exactly as they do. A two-block control compensates and entrains inside each block and not across, and is the only form the test picks out. The study and its wording are the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |
| [CASE-347](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-347.md) | Priced lagged block test on three populations | [LEAD-026](../../../record/leads.d/LEAD-026.md) asked for [CASE-101](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-101.md)'s three populations to be run through [QUESTION-115](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-115.md)'s search and a lagged block criterion ([QUESTION-116](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-116.md)). Four populations of six member slots with the same turnover were simulated, matched in member variance, member correlation and the aggregate's lag-1 autocorrelation: common input (A), norms transmitted at a lag of eight steps (B), an institution that trains, selects and answers to its members (C), and the same institution deaf to them (C0). A block test priced by [CLAIM-154](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-154.md)'s rule, over all subsets and windows of 1 to 16 steps, finds B's members alone, with the strongest support at the transmission lag. It joins A's members to their driver and C's and C0's to their institution, the same verdict for all three. C differs only by a feedback the price removes beyond four steps, and A and C0 get the same verdict on every measure. With the external variable unobserved, every arm's members pass. Retention conditioned on the environment survives turnover only in B; Bourrat's interventional retention of B's members does not, since intervening on the present misses the stored norms. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |

Peng et al. identify the tolerogenic maternal microchimeric subset (LysM+ CD11c+ Vav1+), a conditional depletion handle (maternal-only DTR + diphtheria toxin), two functional readouts of noninherited-maternal-antigen (NIMA) tolerance (NIMA-specific FOXP3+ Treg expansion; cross-generational resiliency against fetal wastage), and the fact that the tolerance requires ongoing stimulation while the cells persist autonomously. | [CASE-365](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-365.md) | Nuclei that make their own teachers | [LEAD-093](../../../record/leads.d/LEAD-093.md) asked for a nucleus that, once formed, takes part in producing or repairing the constraints of its own formation, and a measure of when that loop closes ([QUESTION-399](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-399.md)), with a student that becomes a teacher ([QUESTION-361](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-361.md), [CASE-190](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-190.md)). In the model built here, nuclei form fast only where a teacher is present, cooperatively, and each nucleus makes teachers from material. At the base point, founding by an outside teacher is needed and the loop then holds with the outside teacher withdrawn; it stops closing above a teacher turnover of 0.19, and the material supply can never be withdrawn. The moment withdrawal becomes safe is a crossing of a separatrix in the joint state, reached while nuclei are 0.02 % to 30 % of their maintained number and the self-made share of teacher supply is anywhere from 0.2 % to 65 %. Beyond a turnover of about 0.73 the loop costs more outside teacher supply than no loop. Nuclei that repair teachers without making them divide the supply needed by 1 + ρN/λ and never close. Populations matched in nucleus number close or not by the share of nuclei that can teach. In finite numbers the closed loop is lost after a time that grows roughly exponentially with size. The model and its rates are the assistant's, invented. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |

Share of engagement inside the class rose from 0.42 to 0.90 whenever the classes were used. In the world where exposure alone made the clusters, inference recovered the exposure communities exactly, stability was 1.00 and fit to raw counts was higher than for planted genres, while the random-exposure gap was 0.00; it rose to 0.024 only when the classes were used with adaptation. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |

| [CASE-411](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-411.md) | Eleven open-source successions | [CASE-223](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-223.md)'s design run on public records: eleven cases from the record's own list and the lead's brief (eight contested, two accepted, one unclassified), coded by rules written before the table, with 51 dated events each read from its source on 2026-11-23. The earliest outside verdicts on a successor were printed in its founders' own announcement (LibreOffice, Valkey) or were a foundation's taking it in (OpenTofu, Valkey, Forgejo). A response by an organization independent of the founders was found in four contested cases, after 0 to 1,189 days; three of the four were the speaker's announcement of its own move, and the one statement made before a move (Fedora's proposal to replace Redis) gave the licence as its only reason. The only verdict found dated before the move it decided is the Hudson community's rename vote (214 to 14), whose voters were the movers. Recognition went to the successor in both cases where the creator or the body of core maintainers moved (Jenkins, Libera Chat), split where part of the core moved (MariaDB, Valkey), and no successor took the original's name except io.js, by reunion. Only Hudson's line stopped producing, 2,294 days or fewer after the vote; the other originals still release. The public records cannot time verdicts apart from migration, which is [ARG-067](../../../record/arguments.d/ARG-067.md)'s critical question. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |
